game_concept: A strategy race set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time apples reach the throne, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Increase a counter variable every time apples reach the throne, stacking the tower higher. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herald ahead. Then check the delivered value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the throne by solving code steps involving delivered that move the herald forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the throne first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Counter Tower
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Counter Tower' (Week 1 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Festival Grounds'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how delivered changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Festival Grounds.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
